display.purpose: Page titles only, one per screen above the plate rule.

body.purpose: Prose voice: transcripts, leads, labels. 13px base, never below 12px rendered.

overline.purpose: The instrument voice: plate headers and record keys, uppercase mono at 10px, 0.14em tracking.

readout.purpose: Tabular accounting: indices, durations, timestamps, link state, counts. Mono 11px, tabular figures.

shadows.name: chrome-offset-dark
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system: directional depth under floating translucent chrome (composer, tasks pill).

shadows.name: chrome-offset-light
shadows.purpose: Light-theme variant of the chrome offset; softened to ink.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: Live presence marks breathe on the crew roster; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ping-soft
motion.purpose: Attention marks ping once per cycle; motion-safe only.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.value: shadcn shimmer utility on the trace title
motion.purpose: A running tool call's title shimmers; motion-reduce:shimmer-none.

motion.name: collapse
motion.purpose: Trace and collapsible bodies open with a height transition.

motion.name: caret-pulse
motion.purpose: The newest streaming block ends in a pulsing block caret.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The owner-acting accent: warm ivory fill, dark ink text, 8px radius, 2rem height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.5rem); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 65%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered button on ground; hover fills to the muted tier.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.5rem); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 65%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Quiet chrome: transparent until hover, the default for copy and ellipsis triggers.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Station options"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="3" r="1.25" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.25" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="8" cy="13" r="1.25" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.5rem); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 65%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Crew Row
components.description: One crew member on the console rail: spectral avatar, name, right-aligned live state mark.
components.css: .ds-crew-row { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.5rem); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-crew-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-accent) 60%, transparent); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); } .ds-crew-row.ds-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); font-weight: 500; } .ds-crew-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 65%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-avatar { --spec: oklch(0.82 0.1 85); --spec-soft: color-mix(in oklch, var(--spec) 16%, transparent); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--spec-soft); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--spec) 62%, var(--foreground)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--spec) 30%, transparent); font: 600 0.625rem/1 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-name { min-width: 0; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mark { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-live { color: var(--live); } .ds-breathe { animation: ds-breathe 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.55; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-breathe { animation: none; } }

components.name: Trace Line
components.description: The numbered overlay row: family icon or state mark, zero-padded index in the readout voice, owner-worded title, tabular duration.
components.css: .ds-trace-line { display: flex; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.4375rem); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-trace-line:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-trace-line:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-trace-index { font-family: var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono Variable", monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 1.25rem; text-align: right; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 50%, transparent); user-select: none; } .ds-trace-title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-trace-detail { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 70%, transparent); } .ds-trace-duration { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono Variable", monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 70%, transparent); }

components.name: Error Note
components.description: A failed call's error line in signal red: tinted border and 5% fill, the drawn error mark, the payload's own words.
components.html: The call timed out after 20 s.
components.css: .ds-error-note { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: 48rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--signal) 25%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.5rem); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--signal) 5%, transparent); color: var(--signal); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-error-note svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Overline Plate with Plate Rule
components.description: The section seam: an uppercase mono overline sealed by a hairline with one graduation tick.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-overline { font-family: var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono Variable", monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-plate-rule { position: relative; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-plate-rule::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 0; top: -3px; width: 1px; height: 5px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 28%, transparent); }

components.name: Chrome Float Composer
components.description: The floating pill: 72% translucent ground, 20px blur, hairline edge, one downward offset shadow — the system's only shadow.
components.css: .ds-chrome-float { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 72%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.15); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.15); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -16px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.55); } .ds-readout { font-family: var(--font-mono, "Geist Mono Variable", monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-chrome-text { font: 400 0.8125rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Spectral Avatar
components.description: A bot's face: round initials plate in the hashed spectral tint, soft fill, mixed text, inset spec ring.
components.css: .ds-spec-avatar { --spec: oklch(0.76 0.13 60); --spec-soft: color-mix(in oklch, var(--spec) 16%, transparent); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--spec-soft); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--spec) 62%, var(--foreground)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--spec) 30%, transparent); font: 600 0.6875rem/1 var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); }

narrative.overview: spreissen is the owner's night station for a crew of autonomous entities. The visual world is an observatory control room: deep blue-black ground, warm-tinted ivory ink, hairline seams at one device pixel, and instruments set in a mono voice under quiet sans prose. Every bot is a catalogued object with a spectral class; every state is a drawn mark, never an emoji, never a glow. The category-default floating-pill chat shell survives only as furniture — the identity is the console rail, the roster, the readouts. The system is built for one person reading for hours in the dark: instrument-grade calm, high density, tabular numbers everywhere anything is counted, and exactly one red light reserved for what demands the owner. Chrome floats translucent over the transcript so the prose terrain stays continuous; tool activity rides above it as a numbered overlay layer, never mixed into the prose. Expansion always explains — shaped bodies, definition lists, receipts one click away — never dumps raw JSON at the owner when a lens knows the call.
keyCharacteristics: Four lightness elevation tiers on one blue-black hue; depth by tier, not by shadow
Two typographic voices: Geist Mono as the instrument (overlines, readouts, accounting), Geist Sans for prose
Star-catalog spectral tints (O B A F G K M) as bot identity, hashed from id — identity, not decoration
One disciplined signal light: red only for what demands the owner, amber only for live work, green only for what settled
State read through a small vocabulary of drawn SVG marks, one consistent stroke
Hairline borders, plate rules with a graduation tick, no glow anywhere

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is reserved for what demands the owner. Amber means working, green means settled, red means the owner is needed. A screen shows red only where an owner decision or a failure lives.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing glows. Presence and work are stated with drawn marks and opacity breathing, never box-shadow glows, text-shadows, or luminous halos.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every seam is a 1px translucent-ink hairline from the theme (--border), never a solid gray and never thicker than a device pixel.

rules.name: The Instrument Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything counted, measured, or hashed renders in Geist Mono with tabular figures. Anything said in prose renders in Geist Sans. A number inside a sentence is prose; a number in a column, a duration, or an index is an instrument readout.

rules.name: The Offset Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow appears only on floating translucent chrome, points straight down, and is negative-spread tightened. Flat surfaces never gain shadows to look clickable.

rules.name: The Sinking Transcript Rule
rules.body: Content approaching floating chrome fades under it (mask gradient); it is never clipped by a hard edge.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, text-signal) — every color on screen routes through one; never a raw hex or Tailwind palette color.
Do render all counts, durations, indices and timestamps with .readout or .tnum (tabular figures) in Geist Mono.
Do state every state through the Mark vocabulary with its tone; keep marks at row scale (14px) and one stroke.
Do keep transcript text ≥ 12px, form controls at 16px on phones, touch targets ≥ 44px, and focus rings on every interactive element.
Do fold long prose (> 1200 chars or 24 lines) behind a mask fade with a readout-voiced "Show more" — the fold is a reading aid, never a wall.
Do respect reduced motion: breathing, pinging, shimmering and the streaming caret all stop (motion-safe / motion-reduce guards).
donts: Don't glow. No box-shadow halos, no text-shadows, no luminous accents; the signal light is a color, not a lamp.
Don't spend signal red on anything the owner isn't being asked to look at, and don't spend amber on anything that isn't running right now.
Don't mix tool output into the prose terrain; tool activity stays in the numbered Trace overlay, and raw JSON never appears where a shaped lens exists.
Don't cast shadows on flat surfaces or use solid-gray borders; depth is tier, seams are hairlines.
Don't introduce emoji, glyph icons, or a second icon set — Lucide line icons and the drawn marks are the whole vocabulary.
Don't invent a new elevation tier, radius step, or accent hue; extend the existing four tiers, the --radius scale, and the spectral set.
